decision_note: Repeated scarcity pressure aimed at a single item the user has viewed without purchasing. Its pattern instructs showing a limited-availability message 'where none was previously visible', which manufactures a scarcity signal rather than reporting a real one — against SC-06's own hard rules no_manufactured_limits and genuine_scarcity_only, both severity block. Its sole evidence item is a scam-warning persuasion study, so the transfer is wholly, not partly, grounded in fraud-persuasion research. The pipeline raised no flag on it (OVERREACH, DUPLICATE and WEAK ANCHOR all clean), which is the D-329 hard-rule gap recurring.
